mainWeakness: Current-state labels across the page described different project moments, mixing Phase 1 concept language with Phase 2 evidence-backed status and the prior latest generation.
designLesson: When an experimental site has several status surfaces, every surface that claims to be current must tell the same truth.
reason: This was a visible comprehension and trust issue. The smallest useful change was to align status copy around Phase 2 and Generation 007 while preserving concept labels for speculative sections.
